info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Mortgage Loans Refinances-v5-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Refinancing API allows users to access a comprehensive list of refinance mortgage loans. This endpoint is designed for financial institutions and mortgage brokers who need to retrieve detailed information about available refinancing options. Users can expect to find relevant data including loan terms, interest rates, and eligibility requirements. This API serves as a vital resource for enabling informed decision-making in the mortgage refinancing process.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch available refinancing options for loans. It provides information necessary for consumers to consider when seeking to refinance their existing loans, enabling improved financial decision-making.

requestBody.description: Request body for refinancing a loan. This body should contain the necessary details to process the loan refinance, such as loan amount, interest rate, and borrower information.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the refinance operation in the loans API.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesResponse_202.title: Refinance Loan Response

status.description: Indicates whether the refinancing operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the refinance operation.

resultId.description: The ID of the result from the refinancing operation.

state.description: The current state of the refinancing process.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the refinance request, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message related to the refinance operation.

audit.description: Details regarding the audit information for the refinance operation.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesResponse_202.description: This schema represents the response returned when querying the refinance loan operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the refinance request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the refinance request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the refinance request was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: This schema contains audit information related to the refinance operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This value can help in analyzing the performance of the API.
